svg.title: GRU cell
svg.desc: Reset gate r_t scales h_t-1 before it enters the candidate; x_t enters the candidate unscaled; update gate z_t blends the candidate with h_t-1. No separate cell state. Values from the worked example.
svg.text: GRU: one state line h, two gates,
ht becomes ht-1 of the next cell.
Worked example: x = 1, ht-1 = 0.5. With zt near 0
the cell copies ht-1; with zt near 1 it takes
